worker_message_templates.english: Mausam Dhaal Alert: Extreme humid heat today (WBGT 31.5°C). Your income protection payout of ₹400 has been sent to your registered account. Please rest in the shade from 12 PM to 4 PM and drink ORS water.
worker_message_templates.hindi: मौसम ढाल अलर्ट: आज अत्यधिक उमस भरी गर्मी (WBGT 31.5°C) है। आपके पंजीकृत खाते में ₹400 की सुरक्षा राशि भेज दी गई है। कृपया दोपहर 12 से 4 बजे तक छाया में विश्राम करें और पर्याप्त पानी व ओआरएस पिएं।
worker_message_templates.gujarati: મોસમ ઢાલ એલર્ટ: આજે અતિશય ભેજવાળી ગરમી (WBGT 31.5°C) છે. તમારા ખાતામાં ₹400 ની સહાય રકમ જમા કરવામાં આવી છે. કૃપા કરીને બપોરે 12 થી 4 છાંયડામાં આરામ કરો અને ORS તેમજ પાણી પીવો.

employer_advisory.subject: Urgent Heat Advisory: Informal Worker Workplace Heat Protection Protocol
employer_advisory.body: This is an automated heat protection advisory issued under the Mausam Dhaal framework. Wet-bulb temperatures in your region have breached 30.2°C (High Heat Stress). Employers and platform operators are requested to: (1) Suspend heavy outdoor labor between 12:00 PM and 4:00 PM, (2) Provide free shaded resting points and ORS solution, (3) Do not penalize delivery partners or field staff for slower service during peak heat hours.

city_action_checklist.task: Activate municipal cool-roof shelters and public water kiosks
Alert primary health centres for heatstroke admissions & IV stock
